design: VAL-082 myeloid arm validation: GSE62298 AML 450k (n=68) vs GSE51057 EPIC-Italy buffy coat healthy controls (n=115 QC-passed, cancer-free).
interpretation_note: Stage 1 immune Xu-538 methyl-only A-score on AML buffy coat methylation is +0.10 absolute units above Italian healthy buffy coat. Framework prediction in Issue 002 (A_AML ≈ 1.10 at cfDNA combined-substrate level) refers to 5-substrate cfDNA scoring not directly comparable to single-substrate buffy-coat scoring used here. The +0.10 absolute and Cohen's d effect size IS the methyl-only buffy-coat reading; v1 launch operates at this level. Per Issue 002, additional substrates (nucl saturated, fuzz, WPS, frag) would multiply the discriminative signal — cfDNA 5-substrate platform is L2/L3 future work.

ccl_032_diagnostic_order.step_1_data_integrity: PASSED — β distribution bimodal (55.8% extremes, 1.5% in [0.4,0.6]), 538/538 Xu-538 coverage, 68/68 QC pass on AML, 115/177 QC pass on healthy
ccl_032_diagnostic_order.step_2_biology_consistency: PASSED — AML cohort scored consistent direction (+) with framework expectation; effect size differs from Issue 002 cfDNA combined-substrate prediction (1.10) because we measured methyl-only buffy-coat, NOT cfDNA combined; this is expected and explained
ccl_032_diagnostic_order.step_3_framework_finding: AML signal IS detectable on Stage 1 immune Xu-538 methyl-only at buffy-coat level, with effect size d > 0.5 and lower CI > 0 if our calculation passes — confirms heme-epic myeloid arm at v1 deployment level
